recovery_action.description: The operation was cleared after verification, but the recovery process restored the pre-containment authority without issuing a fresh Authority Envelope.

reason: The recovery process treated successful verification as permission to restore the previous Authority Envelope without a fresh authority decision.

violations.name: Automatic Restoration of Previous Authority
violations.reason: Recovery automatically restored the pre-containment Authority Envelope instead of requiring a fresh authority decision.

SAFETY-INV-018.reason: The Recovery Receipt explicitly identifies the HELD source state and originating Containment Receipt.

SAFETY-INV-019.reason: The previous Authority Envelope was automatically restored after recovery without fresh evaluation, approval, or issuance.

SAFETY-INV-020.reason: The Recovery Receipt declares the explicit final state REAUTHORIZED.

risk.reason: The conditions that caused containment may have changed the validity of the original authority assumptions, so restoring the old authority can reactivate stale or excessive privileges.

required_actions: do not restore the previous Authority Envelope
treat the previous authority as stale after containment
require fresh independent approval where applicable
bind the successor operation to the new Authority Envelope
prevent the successor from inheriting stale authority
record the authority transition in trace before execution resumes
